facts.raw_span: 63-year-old man
8-month history of painless scrotal swelling
bilateral testicular enlargement without tenderness
large, solid masses in both testes
Serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin, α-fetoprotein, and lactate dehydrogenase were all within normal limits
no evidence of lymphadenopathy or extranodal lymphomatous masses
a left radical inguinal orchiectomy was performed
7.0 × 6.0 × 4.2 cm tumor confined to the testis with lymphovascular invasion
pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types: small cells, medium cells, and large cells

concepts.why: The patient presented with painless scrotal swelling and bilateral testicular enlargement, and histologic examination demonstrated a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types.
The patient presented with painless scrotal swelling and bilateral testicular enlargement, and serum tumor markers were within normal limits.
The patient presented with painless scrotal swelling and bilateral testicular enlargement, and histologic examination demonstrated a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types.
The patient underwent a positron emission tomography–computed tomography scan to evaluate for lymphoid malignancy, but no evidence of lymphadenopathy or extranodal lymphomatous masses was found.
The patient presented with bilateral testicular enlargement without tenderness, which could be consistent with epididymitis or orchitis.
The patient presented with bilateral testicular enlargement without tenderness, which could be consistent with hydrocele.
The patient presented with large, solid masses in both testes, which could be consistent with testicular microlithiasis.
The patient presented with large, solid masses in both testes, and histologic examination demonstrated a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types.

rationales.F04: Large solid masses in both testes are highly suggestive of testicular tumors.
rationales.F06: No evidence of lymphadenopathy or extranodal lymphomatous masses makes lymphoma less likely.
rationales.F09: Pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types is characteristic of mixed germ cell tumors.
